name: Yukima
use: The seasonal template. Cool blue-grey field, slate accent, an earth-and-growth categorical ramp, built on 60-30-10. For research write-ups, ESG and sustainability reporting, long-form analysis — anything wanting a quieter, more natural register than ANA Blue. Do not mix with another template in one file.

geometry.radius_note: deck-build takes one radius; the template's own panels run 2.0-26.0pt by role. See references/grid.md.

proportions.note: #4B6F87 appears in both bands: as type it is supporting, as area it is accent. #22333D and #3B576A are derived — the source palette contains no ink.

derived.#22333D: headline ink — #4B6F87 darkened on the same hue to 12.00:1 on the field
derived.#3B576A: muted ink — #4B6F87 darkened on the same hue to 7.00:1 on the field
derived.#4D7B57: text-safe 常磐木 — #558860 darkened to 4.50:1 on the field

japanese_names.#F1F6FA: 寒の戻り kan-no-modori — the cold's return
japanese_names.#E1EDD5: 三寒四温 sankan-shion — three cold days, four warm
japanese_names.#86B655: 萌黄 moegi — fresh bud green

discipline: Built on 60-30-10 by area. 60% field: #F1F6FA page with #C8DAE8 inset, #F5F3F1 lifted and #AACEE7 rules, all within 1.52:1 of each other so the tints read as one family. 30% supporting: derived inks #22333D and #3B576A, plus #4B6F87 where the blue is type. 10% accent: #4B6F87 as area with #558860 as a second fill. The accent is text-safe, so like ANA Blue it occupies both the 30% and the 10%; the ceiling governs area, not type. Cover, Section Divider and Closing are full-bleed accent by design and exempt. Cool-to-warm categorical ramp reads snow through growth to earth. No shadows, no coloured field beyond those three layouts.
never: white text on a #86B655 萌黄 or #D2AD52 gold fill (2.38:1 and 2.13:1 — both take #22333D ink at 5.49 and 6.12)
#558860 常磐木 as text below 24px (3.80:1 on the field — use the derived #4D7B57 at 4.50)
#7499BA, #AACEE7, #C8DAE8, #CAD2C4, #E1EDD5, #86B655, #9A9641 or #D2AD52 as text at any size
any source colour other than #4B6F87 as body text — this palette has no native ink, which is why two are derived
a green or gold fill behind a table header row; use #4B6F87 or #3B576A
more than one accent as area per page
coloured slide fields outside Cover / Section Divider / Closing
中文 without font.ea set to 微軟正黑體
mixing this identity with ANA Blue or Reiser Warm in one file
